Ben / Alex — quick technical reply with suggested targets and notes based on the 2k seq baseline: 

Suggested throughput lanes (per replica):
- Baseline (steady-state): 120 tokens/sec per GPU replica (quantized int8 path)
- Burst (short sustained): 300 tokens/sec per replica for up to 10m windows (aggressive batching)
- Stress (validation): push to 800–1,000 tokens/sec per replica for short bursts to validate graceful degradation

Latency expectations (single-region, 8xA100-ish class):
- p50: 30–45 ms per token at steady-state
- p95: 80–120 ms depending on batch size and KV hit rate
- p99: 200–350 ms under transient queues; recommend circuit-breaker at 500 ms

Operational notes:
- KV cache warm-up: run a 15m prefix warm with realistic prompt set before steady-state measurement; cold start will add 200–400 ms.
- Pre-warm kernels and pinned replicas: if you need consistent p95 under 100 ms, reserve 1–2 pinned reps for critical routes.
- Network: recommend test from your US-east users and a separate run from EU to capture cross-region variance.
- Telemetry: we'll provide token-level cost + latency traces and a per-route dashboard after the run.

Test windows: Thu 10/22 16:00 PDT looks safe for maintenance, but if Emma is only available Fri morning, Fri 10/23 08:30 PDT works — we can compress the test to a 30m targeted readout (warm -> 10m steady -> 10m burst -> quick readout).

I've attached a quick cluster layout snapshot to show where KV cache and routing layers sit.
